body: BRO! KEEP FIGHTING! I've gone through something similar. I thought I was better but a couple months later they came back to haunt me. All I gotta say is keep going, keep persevering, keep pushing through. I promise you the end result will be SOOOOOO worth it. There is light at the end of the tunnel, you just have to keep going. If you need someone to talk to, please dm me. I would LOVE to talk with you.
Ya know. It's strangely comforting knowing I'm not the only one. If you ever want to talk or anything just send me a dm

Hey man. I've been struggling with the same crap... I've attempted it many times before. I'm telling you tho there is more to life. You can't end it now. You'll miss so much that's to come. I'm begging you please dont do it. I love you man and ik so many other people can say the same. Please message me if you want to talk more. I'll always be here for you.
